title: Single local project-folder export + improved delivery docs and ZIP export output

requirements.summary: Add a delivery script to export the entire repository into a single local project folder with the same exclusions as the ZIP export.
acceptanceCriteria: A new script exists under frontend/delivery/ that creates a single folder containing the whole project (one top-level directory)
The script excludes the same directories already excluded by frontend/delivery/export-zip.sh (.git, node_modules, dist, build, .dfx, frontend/delivery/exports, etc.)
Running the script twice does not corrupt previous exports (either creates a timestamped folder or cleanly overwrites a dedicated output folder)
The script prints the final on-disk path of the generated project folder using English-only output

file_operations.description: Create a bash delivery script that uses the repo root as input and writes a single exported project directory under frontend/delivery/exports/ (e.g., timestamped) while excluding the same directories as export-zip.sh (including .git, node_modules, dist, build, .dfx, and frontend/delivery/exports). Ensure reruns are safe (timestamped output folder or clean overwrite) and print the final absolute on-disk output path using English-only messages.

requirements.summary: Update delivery documentation with complete English instructions for exporting a single project folder and optionally creating a ZIP export.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/delivery/README.md includes complete, properly formatted instructions (no truncated code blocks)
Docs include: command(s) to run, expected output location, and what to do next to run the app locally (install dependencies + start dev server)
All user-facing text in the updated docs is in English

file_operations.description: Rewrite/complete the delivery README to include properly formatted, non-truncated code blocks that show exact commands to run from the repository root for (1) creating the single exported project folder via the new script and (2) optionally creating the ZIP via export-zip.sh. Document the exact output locations on disk (frontend/delivery/exports/...) and include next steps for running locally (install dependencies + start dev server). Ensure all user-facing text is English-only.

requirements.summary: Ensure the existing ZIP export remains single-top-level-folder and uses English-only console output with a final full ZIP path.
acceptanceCriteria: The resulting ZIP contains a single top-level directory (no files at the ZIP root)
The script prints the full output ZIP path at the end

file_operations.description: Update console output to be English-only (remove emoji-only cues) and ensure the final line prints the full absolute ZIP path. Preserve the current behavior that produces a ZIP containing exactly one top-level folder (the staged directory) and no files at the ZIP root.
